name: カメラマン
text:
──はい、とってもいい感じです！
じゃあ次は……夏真っ盛り、って感じの笑顔くださーい
trans:
──Yes, that was fantastic! Next up, can I get a
smile filled with the feeling of summer, please!

name: 雛菜
trans: Aha～

name: 雛菜
text: 夏祭り、今週の土曜日なんだ～
trans: The Summer Festival's this Saturday, huh～

name: 一同
trans: Ahaha.

name: 雛菜
text: 土曜日は、お仕事ないし……
trans: Hmm, and we have no work on Saturday too.....

name: 雛菜
text: お祭り、行きたかったな～
trans: I really wanted to go to the festival～

name: 円香
text:
こっちの夏祭りでも
やることは変わらないんじゃない？
trans:
Well, this and that,
aren't all festivals the same old thing?

name: 円香
text: まあ、こっちは撮影用のセットだけど
trans: Even though this one's just a set for the shoot.

name: 雛菜
text:
ん～……
そうなんだけど、そうじゃない～
trans:
Yea～......
Well yes, but it's not about that～

name: 小糸
text:
で、でも……すごいよね！
本当のお祭りに来たみたい
trans:
B-But...... This is amazing!
It's like we're really at a festival.

name: 透
trans:
Yeah.
They even have stalls here.

name: 透
trans: So, what do we do?

name: 小糸
text: 自由にしてていいって言われたけど……
trans: They did say we're free to do anything......

name: 小糸
text:
ほかの人たちみたいに
楽しそうにしてたほうがいいのかな……？
trans:
Maybe we can just look like we're having fun like
everyone else......?

name: 雛菜
text:
そうなんじゃない～？
雛菜はいつも楽しいけどね～
trans:
I'm not talking about that though～?
Cos Hinana's always having fun～

name: 小糸
trans: Then we just go about it as usual......?

name: 円香
text:
やってみて
ダメって言われたら、変えればいい
trans:
Let's try that first.
We'll just switch it up if they say it's no good.

name: 小糸
trans: I-I suppose we can do that......

name: 雛菜
text: じゃあ雛菜は透先輩と一緒になんかやる～！
trans: I'll go do something with Toru-senpai, then～!

name: 透
trans: Alryー

name: 雛菜
text: 雛菜、型抜きやってみたい～

name: 透
trans: Okaayー

name: 小糸
text:
……あ
雛菜ちゃん、透ちゃん……待って！
trans:
......Ah.
Wait, Hinana-chan, Toru-chan......!

name: 透
trans: Heeyー, aim for that one.

name: 円香
trans: Which?

name: 透
trans: Chocolate, the one in the tube.

name: 円香
trans: ......That's impossible. Tube's too thin.

name: 雛菜
trans: Ah～  But Hinana wants it too～

name: 小糸
trans: Madoka-chan...... You can do it──

name: 円香
text:
小糸、手
さっきのチョコ
trans:
Gimme your hand, Koito.
Here's the chocolate from earlier.

name: 小糸
trans: O-Okay!

name: 小糸
trans: Ehehe...... Thank you.

name: 円香
trans: Uhm.

name: 雛菜
text:
円香先輩～
雛菜、もうちょっと欲しい～
trans:
Madoka-senpai～
Hinana wants some more～

name: 雛菜
trans: Yaha～

name: 撮影スタッフ
text:
──はい、いただきましたー！　ひとつのチョコを
みんなで分け合うとか、幼なじみって感じでいいですね！
trans:
──Oh yes, now that's the shot─!
Sharing a tube of chocolate brings the childhood
friend feels, eh?

name: 撮影スタッフ
text:
すごくいい感じですので、
引き続き、その空気感でお願いしますねー！
trans:
It's looking fantastic, so keep this mood going
forward, pleaseー!

name: 一同
trans: Alright.

name: 雛菜
trans:
......Ah.
Madoka-senpai, gimme chocolate～

name: 円香
trans:
Aahh......
──Here, gimme your hand.

name: 雛菜
trans: Yaay～

name: 雛菜
text: 最後の一個だったんだね～
trans: That was the last one, huh～

name: 円香
text: ほとんど雛菜が食べたんだけど
trans: You ate most of them, though.

name: 雛菜
trans: Did I～?

name: 雛菜
text:
でも、いっか～
食べちゃお～
trans:
Ah well, it's alright～
I'll eat them all up～
